name: moh731V2023PrepVisitsBase
description: MOH 731 (Ver. July 2023) PrEP, step 3: the PrEP visits -- one per client per day (the latest), Follow-ups unless PrEP was not prescribed, and each client's latest Initial in the period where PrEP was prescribed -- with population, transfer-in, PrEP start, status, type, regimen, HIV test and STI. Carries a flag per MOH 731 PrEP figure, which the aggregates sum and the patient list filters on.

join.joinCondition: b.pop_id IS NULL AND ipop.obs_id = (SELECT o2.obs_id FROM amrs.encounter e2 JOIN amrs.obs o2 ON o2.encounter_id = e2.encounter_id AND o2.concept_id = 9782 AND o2.voided = 0 WHERE e2.patient_id = b.patient_id AND e2.encounter_type = 133 AND e2.voided = 0 ORDER BY (e2.encounter_datetime <= b.encounter_datetime) DESC, e2.encounter_datetime DESC, o2.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)
pop_cn.concept_id = COALESCE(pop.value_coded, ipop.value_coded) AND pop_cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND pop_cn.voided = 0
st_cn.concept_id = st.value_coded AND st_cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND st_cn.voided = 0
hv_cn.concept_id = hv.value_coded AND hv_cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND hv_cn.voided = 0
pn.person_name_id = (SELECT pn2.person_name_id FROM amrs.person_name pn2 WHERE pn2.person_id = p.person_id AND pn2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: CASE b.encounter_type WHEN 133 THEN 'Initial' ELSE 'Follow-up' END
DATE(b.encounter_datetime)
(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 8 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 45 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, b.encounter_datetime)

CASE WHEN COALESCE(pop.value_coded, ipop.value_coded) IS NULL THEN 'Not recorded' WHEN COALESCE(pop.value_coded, ipop.value_coded) IN (8291, 9785) THEN 'MSM/MSW' WHEN COALESCE(pop.value_coded, ipop.value_coded) IN (9786) THEN 'FSW' WHEN COALESCE(pop.value_coded, ipop.value_coded) IN (105) THEN 'PWID/PWUD' WHEN COALESCE(pop.value_coded, ipop.value_coded) IN (6096, 12067) THEN 'Discordant Couple' WHEN COALESCE(pop.value_coded, ipop.value_coded) IN (6966, 11232, 9784, 12251, 11288, 6578) THEN 'Vulnerable Pop.'
